$description: WinUI 3 (light appearance, pointer tier) — standalone W3C DTCG 2025.10 tokens.

sharedDos: Read all colors, radii, typography, and surface finishes through theme roles (`colors.*`, `shape.*`, `font.*`, `finish.*`) rather than literals in component code.
Read theme getters inside JSX render expressions or reactive effects so runtime theme switching (`selectTheme`) and light/dark appearance changes take effect on the next frame.
Use `rounded(shape.<role>, inset)` for concentric nested radii inside cards, switches, and segmented controls.
sharedDonts: Never write color literals (`#...`, `rgb()`, `oklch()`) in component, lib, or demo-adapter code.
Never store `colors.*`, `finish.*`, or `shape.*` values in module-level constants; they freeze on theme or appearance switches.
Never delete finish fields or alter the merged finish key set across appearances or themes.
designMd.voiceOmitted: Voice & Content Strategy is intentionally omitted: this theme defines visual tokens, surface finishes, typography metrics, and motion physics only; product copy, tone, capitalization, and terminology belong to the host application.
designMd.overview: WinUI 3 (`winui3/release/2.7.0`): Windows 11 fill and stroke resources composited over `SolidBackgroundFillColorBase` (`#F3F3F3` light / `#202020` dark) with `#0078D4` accent, `Segoe UI Variable` + `Consolas`, double focus strokes, and deterministic timing curves.
designMd.elevation: WinUI 3 ThemeShadow depths (2/8/16/32/128) paired with composited `ControlStrokeColorDefault` / `SurfaceStrokeColorDefault` borders and `material.windows` blur on `glass`, `menu`, and `tooltip` (`AcrylicInAppFillColorDefault` 0.85 light / 0.96 dark).
dos: Use `4px` `ControlCornerRadius` for `control` and `8px` `OverlayCornerRadius` for `container` and `modal` with `shape.curve: "circular"`.
Use `focus.style: "double"` (2px outer `FocusStrokeColorOuter` + 1px inner `FocusStrokeColorInner`) and WinUI timing motion (`decelerate` / `point-to-point`).
Use `controls: "winui"` (underlined tabs/fields and leading navigation bar indicators) with `Segoe UI Variable` (`{font.family.sans}`).
donts: Do not substitute continuous squircle corners or spring physics for WinUI 3's circular corners and timing curves.
